caption: The drawing depicts two views of the same hooded cloak garment, shown side by side on a plain, beige background. Both cloaks are colored in light brown, with faint shading to suggest folds and draping. The left figure shows the back of the cloak, with a rounded hood that has gathered stitching at the back and a wide, loose cape that falls in gentle pleats. The right figure shows the cloak from the front, revealing an open hood framing an empty face space, a capelet at the top, and a long, pale blue ribbon tied in a bow at the neck with two ribbon ends hanging down the front. The hem of the cloak in both views is slightly uneven to indicate the softness of the material. Below the right cloak, the text "Frances Ditto Bruner" is written in black ink; faintly, the same text appears above it in pencil. The background is lightly mottled with some faint stains.
title: Shaker Cape
